description: This file defines the interface for Zigbee cluster management, including data structures, function pointers for handling cluster operations, and metadata management functions within a Zigbee device driver context.

methods.name: addBoolConfigurationMetadata
methods.description: Adds a boolean value to the configuration metadata map.

methods.name: getBoolConfigurationMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from the configuration metadata map, or returns a default if not found.

methods.name: addNumberConfigurationMetadata
methods.description: Adds a numeric (uint64_t) value to the configuration metadata map.

methods.name: getNumberConfigurationMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves a numeric (uint64_t) value from the configuration metadata map, or returns a default if not found.
